scenes.vo: Last night I tried to leave. The sun came up. The door was still locked.
Then the dead radio crackled. Walt's voice. Somebody has to stay, kid. Somebody has to WATCH.
I looked up at the monitor. The counter was empty. I was standing right there, but the camera couldn't SEE me anymore.
A week later, a sign went up in the window. Now hiring. Night shift. Then a nervous kid showed up.
At three A.M., I watched him glance at the monitor. Behind him stood a tall black shape. And right next to it… ME.
So I walked up behind him, the way Walt once did for me. I leaned close to his ear and whispered. Don't look.
